boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission, no-purchase activities supported by current SRU pages; several spaces require an SRU club, class, or organization reservation.

cards.title: Join a ROCK Spin Group Fit class
cards.subtitle: Aebersold Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring an SRU friend, check the semester schedule, and arrive early because class participation can be limited by available equipment.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled group-fitness option that SRU lists as free for students and ARC members.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU states that ROCK Spin Group Fit classes are free to all SRU students and ARC members.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Programs | Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Free for SRU students and ARC members; consult the current class schedule and arrive early if equipment limits apply.

cards.title: Set goals together through Exercise is Medicine
cards.subtitle: SRU campus community program
cards.notes: Contact the SRU leadership team to enroll, then use the twice-weekly sessions as a low-pressure accountability date with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free, structured exercise program with individualized goals and two weekly sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU says its Exercise is Medicine program is open, free, and available to people in and around the campus community.
cards.source_title: Exercise is Medicine-On Campus | Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Contact the listed SRU leadership team before participating; the page describes the program as free and open to individuals in and around campus.

cards.entity_name: Harmony House Classroom Space and Kitchen
cards.title: Plan a club get-together at Harmony House
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Have an SRU club, class, or organization contact the center to reserve the classroom and kitchen for a focused, food-from-home hang.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Macoskey Center classroom-and-kitchen space for SRU groups.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists Harmony House Classroom Space and Kitchen among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; contact the Macoskey Center.

cards.entity_name: Harmony House 2nd Floor Computer Lab and Meeting Space
cards.title: Work side-by-side in the Harmony House lab
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Ask an SRU group to reserve this second-floor computer lab and meeting space, then bring a shared project, game plan, or study list.
cards.short_summary: A small reservable computer-lab and meeting area in Harmony House.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists the Harmony House 2nd Floor Computer Lab and Meeting Space among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU groups can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; capacity listed by SRU is 15.

cards.title: Gather upstairs in Harmony Barn
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Coordinate with your SRU organization to reserve the barn’s second floor for a meeting, craft session, or low-key group conversation.
cards.short_summary: A reservable upper-floor gathering space in the Macoskey Center’s Harmony Barn.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists the second floor of Harmony Barn among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; capacity listed by SRU is 34.

cards.title: Set up a porch conversation
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Reserve the front porch through an SRU club, class, or organization, then use it for a casual agenda-free check-in with your group.
cards.short_summary: A reservable outdoor porch space at the Macoskey Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists the Front Porch among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; capacity listed by SRU is 34.

cards.title: Meet among the Springhouse gardens
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Request a free group reservation for the patio or garden spaces, then bring a sketchbook, conversation prompt, or campus-organization plan.
cards.short_summary: Reservable patio and garden spaces at the Macoskey Center’s Springhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists Springhouse Patio/Garden Spaces among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; contact the Macoskey Center.

cards.title: Take a group trail walk
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Arrange a free SRU-group reservation, choose a daylight time, and make the walk a chance to catch up without needing an itinerary.
cards.short_summary: Trails listed among the Macoskey Center’s no-cost reservable spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists Trails among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; use appropriate outdoor footwear.

cards.title: Hold a backyard campus-group hang
cards.subtitle: The Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Reserve the backyard through an SRU group and keep the plan simple: bring conversation cards, a class activity, or an organization check-in.
cards.short_summary: A reservable outdoor backyard at the Macoskey Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists the Backyard among Macoskey Center spaces that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent for free.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Available only when reserved by an SRU constituent for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; contact the Macoskey Center.

cards.title: Screen a shared project at Harmony House
cards.subtitle: Harmony House Classroom Space and Kitchen, Macoskey Center
cards.notes: Reserve the Harmony House classroom through an SRU group, then use its listed Wi-Fi, laptop, and projector for a collaborative viewing session.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost SRU-group activity using the Harmony House classroom’s listed technology.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU states that SRU clubs, classes, and organizations can rent Macoskey Center space for free, and lists Wi-Fi, a laptop, and projector for the Harmony House Classroom Space and Kitchen.
cards.source_title: Opportunities | The Macoskey Center at Slippery Rock University
cards.access_notes: Requires an SRU constituent to reserve the Harmony House classroom for an SRU club, class, organizational event, or activity; technology availability is listed by SRU.
